items.title: Abby Foster Interview, 1960-06-29
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Is that the same place that P. Rone played later? ... [INTERVIEWEE] He played before?

ctx.x: Yeah, Spanish Fort there. Trench in.
Trench in. Is that the same place that P. Rone played later? Yeah, that's right. No, he played that before.
He played before? Before. We went to Apple. You recorded in the fort? Huh? Where were you recording? No, we was playing at the Spanish Fort.
